role: Separate procedural verifier; cannot edit builder candidate
scope: Source-bound development admission and arithmetic audit, not fresh statistical confirmation or external certification
unchanged_negative_grid: Preserve incumbent/parity/empty successor result and original hashes
question: Does a materially different battery/heat bottleneck justify a construction with independently evidenced useful demand, a causal unmet constraint against a competent complete route, and a defensible complete-cost cohort?

demand: Named beneficiary and completed useful outcome
Observed installation/usage distinguishes host participation from AGI ALPHA purchase acceptance
Market size, grants, R&D allocations and predicted savings are not buyer demand or earned revenue
Vendor-reported validation remains vendor-reported unless separately substantiated
comparators: Strong current rapid EIS/diagnostic and complete safety/traceability/remanufacture routes remain available
No hours-long cycling strawman where equivalent rapid testing is competent
Same chemistry, condition, SOC/voltage window, temperature, current and functional test endpoint or explicit noncomparability
costs: Freeze admitted units and include all rejects, acquisition, transport, preparation, screening, rework, integration, certification, warranty, downtime, disposal/terminal obligations and capacity losses
Distinguish actual incurred costs, quotations, projections, subsidies, transfer prices and R&D commitments
Separate capex, operating profit, NPV and cash; do not count capex and depreciation twice
Inference, search, failures, verification, integration and maintenance unknowns cannot become zero
Cost advantage requires matched complete service and horizon; missing material items block complete-cost claim
causal: Aggregate endpoints with changed voltage/SOC windows do not identify true degradation or predictor accuracy
Known conventional method reproducing an outcome forbids invention superiority
Synthetic curves, assumed demand or desired effect do not confirm physical or commercial improvement

arithmetic_endpoints: Recompute reported fractions directly from identified source numerator/denominator
Preserve raw-Ah vs equivalent-cell minimum/average distinctions
Check totals, currency/base-date, kWh basis and per-admitted vs per-accepted units
Reject unsupported missing-cost imputation or simulated cash relabeled actual

decision_rule.admit_construction: All mandatory service-demand/constraint/cost bounds sufficient for declared bounded experiment; uncertainty explicitly scoped
decision_rule.continue_bounded_probe: One tractable source-bound uncertainty has a decisive low-cost measurement
decision_rule.block_or_retain: Missing necessary physical/raw data, buyer contract, full costs or equal competent alternative solves proposed constraint

failure_behavior: Unresolved evidence disagreements remain UNKNOWN; preserve both outputs and original source identities
